summary: File Browser Bug Fix Verification - COMPLETE. The file browser in Settings > Media Libraries is now fully functional. The fix involved refactoring SettingsPage.js to use the centralized FolderBrowser.jsx component instead of inline implementation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All 9 file browser features tested and working

file_browser_modal_opens.details: Clicking browse button in Media Libraries > Add Library opens 'Browse for Folder' modal

directory_listing.details: Shows folder names with item counts (e.g., 'app (45)', 'backend (40)', 'db (42)')

single_click_navigation.details: Clicking on a folder navigates into it (tested: data, app folders)

go_up_button.details: Go Up button (^) navigates to parent directory (/data -> /)

quick_access_buttons.details: Quick access buttons work: Root, Home, Media, Mount, Server, Data, My Home. Active button highlighted.

select_this_folder.details: Select This Folder button confirms selection, closes modal, and populates path field with selected path. Also auto-populates Library Name from folder name.

path_populated_after_selection.details: After selecting /media, the Folder Path input shows '/media' and Library Name shows 'Media'

cancel_button.details: Cancel button closes modal without selecting - path field remains empty

response_fields_verified: items (with name, path, type, item_count, permission_denied)
drives (Root, Home, Media, Mount, Server, Data, My Home)

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: File Browser in Settings page was broken - SettingsPage.js had its own inline file browser implementation instead of using centralized FolderBrowser.jsx
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Refactored SettingsPage.js to import and use FolderBrowser component from '../components/FolderBrowser'
bug_fix_verification.fix_verified: YES - File browser modal now opens, shows directories, allows navigation, and folder selection works correctly

context_for_next_testing_agent: File Browser bug has been fixed and verified. The centralized FolderBrowser.jsx component is now properly integrated in SettingsPage.js. All 9 file browser features tested: modal opening, path display, directory listing, folder navigation, Go Up, quick access buttons, Select This Folder, path population, and Cancel. The /api/filesystem/browse backend API works correctly with OS-aware path handling.
